name: Essentials
description: Adds many useful features to Minecraft like tree breaker, ore scanner, portable crafting tools, teleporters, and more to make survival easier.
fullDescription:
Essential Additions to Minecraft! Say goodbye to doing boring chores!

• Repairable Anvil
• Sideways Slabs
• Storage Satchels
• Automatic Crop Re-Planting
• Portable Crafting Table, Ender Chest, and Furnace
• Ore Breaker
• Tree Breaker
• Ore Scanners
• Mining Helmet
• Universal Remote – Change Time, Weather & More
• Death Waypoint
• Fake Blocks
• Teleporters
• ...and a lot more!

name: 44 Ways To prank Add-on
description: Adds 44 funny prank items like fake blocks, exploding beds, fake lava, and other surprises to trick your friends.
fullDescription:
44 Ways to Prank Add-On brings 44 hilarious prank items to your world!

• Trick friends with fake blocks
• Exploding beds
• Fake lava
• Exploding cakes
• Prank tables that spawn creepers
• And many more surprises

Fun, unpredictable, and full of laughter every time you play!

name: Action And Stuff 1.9
description: Enhances Minecraft with new player and mob animations, 3D item models, custom armour, and vibrant visual improvements.
fullDescription:
The Animation Pack You Didn't Know You Needed: Bring your world to life with new animations, particles, textures, and more!

• Player Animations (1st & 3rd Person)
• New & Improved Mob Animations
• 3D Item Models
• Custom Armour
• A Complete & Faithful Texture Overhaul
• Compatible with Vanilla Textures or Your Own Texture Packs
• Now with 100% More Vibrant Visuals

name: Streamer Simulator
description: Become a streamer, gain subscribers, upgrade your setup, and grow your streaming empire.
fullDescription:
Start from small beginnings streaming to 0 viewers in your mom's basement.
Then grow a GIANT audience and live in an island mansion — this is Streamer Simulator!

• Stream 5 custom mini-games to gain subscribers and coins
• Random bonus events
• Tons of custom streaming equipment
• Customize your streaming setup
• 2 free skins included
• And more!

name: 100 Days Raft
description: Survive on a raft in the ocean by fishing, gathering resources, and expanding your raft.
fullDescription:
You're stranded on a raft in the middle of the ocean!
Survive by fishing, collecting materials from the water, and expanding your raft.
Trade with Milo for maps to discover new islands.
Can you survive 100 days on a raft?

• Sharks
• Custom weapons
• Custom raft with furniture

name: RLCraft Bedrock Edition 1.2
description: A brutal hardcore survival experience with dungeons, dragons, new gear, and challenging gameplay.
fullDescription:
RLCraft is here — hardcore, unforgiving, and brutally challenging.

• Explore new world generation with structures & dungeons
• Progress your skills and wield powerful gear
• Custom player and weapon animations
• Elemental dragons
• Based on the original RLCraft Modpack by Shivaxi
• You're going to die… a lot

name: Dark Fantasy Visual
description: Adds dark fantasy visuals with moody lighting, shadows, and dramatic atmosphere.
fullDescription:
Immerse yourself in dark fantasy visuals with moody lighting, deep shadows, realistic shading, and clear god rays for a dramatic atmosphere.

[!] Dark Fantasy Visuals is not a shader.
